Snippet pack · Workflow

Review and Revision

Tools for co-writing and revising: visible added, deleted and replaced text, to-do notes, placeholder figures and reviewer response blocks.

What it adds

  • Snippet: Change tracking (preamble)
  • Snippet: Mark added text
  • Snippet: Mark deleted text
  • Snippet: Mark replaced text
  • Snippet: To-do note
  • Snippet: Inline to-do
  • Snippet: Placeholder figure
  • Snippet: Reviewer response block
  • Snippet: Revision note

Tags

  • revision
  • review
  • collaboration

Details

  • Version 1.0.0
  • By LatexDo
  • Identifier latexdo.review-revision

Install Review and Revision

In LatexDo, open the Extensions view, find Review and Revision and choose Install. It is free.
